title: Raffy Tulfo: Witness not ready to explain VP Duterte's GenCorp earnings

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The witness was either “not ready” or “nagmamaang-maangan” (playing dumb) for failing to fully explain the P2 million allegedly received by Vice President Sara Duterte from GenCorp Industries Inc., Senator-judge Raffy Tulfo said on Wednesday. Tulfo made the remark during the Senate impeachment trial after defense witness and lawyer Suzette Balucanag-Punay revealed that the vice president received a total of P2,142,369.14 as a supposed “return of capital.” According to Balucanag-Punay, in-house corporate counsel of GenCorp, Duterte is not listed as a shareholder of the company but has a “loose investment” in one of the Jollibee branches owned and […]...
